purpose: Role-based custody separation for Worldz-owned allocation wallets. This is operational segregation, not a claim of independent ownership or decentralization.

operationsTreasury.rule: Treasury, liquidity reserves, claim vaults and large unallocated reserves remain multisig/program controlled unless a later explicit approved model says otherwise.

plainWalletPolicy.exceptionRule: Target plain owner-controlled EOA balances at or below 2.5% of token supply where practical. Larger balances belong only in clearly disclosed treasury, vesting, claim, liquidity or program custody, or where an already-executed allocation cannot be silently rewritten.

renameTheseWallets.label: WORLDZ • Legacy Custody
renameTheseWallets.intendedUse: Legacy allocation staging only; final eligible recipients remain separately accounted

renameTheseWallets.label: WORLDZ • DevCity Staging
renameTheseWallets.intendedUse: DevCity allocation staging before verified recipient fanout

renameTheseWallets.label: WORLDZ • Team Vesting Staging
renameTheseWallets.intendedUse: Earned team allocations before approved vesting execution

renameTheseWallets.label: MIRACLE • Team Vault
renameTheseWallets.intendedUse: MRCL Miracle Team allocation custody under its separate approval/vesting model

WLDZ.note: Existing allocations remain authoritative. Plain owner-controlled wallet splitting may be used for custody separation, but not to represent the balances as independent holders.

RVIV.note: OneDrop/Legacy/DevCity/Team buckets remain separately accounted. No duplicate distribution is allowed.

PNEX.note: Prelaunch. No owner wallet may substitute for required vesting, Chance, liquidity or FlyWheel custody.

MRCL.note: Planned. Miracle Team and MiracleMagic remain separate. The currently unallocated supply must not be silently assigned.

activationRule: Rename the owner-controlled personal allocation wallets first, then register the exact public addresses. Large community/team/impact/liquidity reserves remain multisig, claim, vesting or program custody rather than being scattered to imitate holder decentralisation.
